486:t_039:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Someday you'll learn, you Wingless...! Just how terrifying the thing beyond the light and darkness you believed in really is!」

486:t_040:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「That parting shot of his is way too poetic. It just doesn't click for me.」

486:t_040:2.en:
$$メール$$
「If thinking about it doesn't get you anywhere, don't sweat it!」

486:t_040:4.en:
$$不動$$
「Stop dwelling on it, $$ミコノ・スズシロ$$. You did what you had to do.」

486:t_040:6.en:
$$不動$$
「There is nothing more I can teach them. Now they must see with their own eyes and advance on their own feet.」

486:t_041:0.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「You cowards, abandoning the True War in the name of a higher-dimensional life form's duty...!」

486:t_041:2.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Here I come, $c! If you say you have accepted the darkness, then rot away within this space!」

486:t_041:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「...We'll die someday too... But today is not that day!」

486:t_041:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「We have things we must do! We won't stop until the day we bring peace back to Earth and the universe!!」

486:t_042:1.en:
$$アキラ$$
「That's all well and good, but...」

486:t_042:2.en:
$$ナオト$$
「Are we even going to be able to get home?」

486:t_042:3.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「There's no need to worry about that.」

486:t_042:4.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Now that you have awakened to the radiance of the sun, and $$ズール$$ and Father have fallen back, the balance of this world is returning to normal.」

486:t_042:5.en:
$$グーラ$$
「This is the world of darkness... The living cannot remain here.」

486:t_042:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I see. So we, the foreign bodies, are being sent back to our own world.」

486:t_043:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「I'm all right, $$ロゼ$$. I may never be able to see Big Bro again, but he is always with me.」

486:t_043:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「So I'm not lonely. I'm just going back to our world with my vow renewed.」

486:t_043:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「That's right. There are still plenty of things left for us to do.」

486:t_043:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go home. So we can fight.」

486:t_043:6.en:
$$タケル$$
「Yeah... Let's keep fighting until the day we bring peace back.」

486:t_043:7.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Distortion of the dimensional boundary line confirmed.」

486:t_044:0.en:
$$タケル$$
(Let's go, Big Bro. Our fight is only just beginning.)

486:t_045:0.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Tch! No wonder they bear the $$烙印$$!」

486:t_045:1.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Meeting these fellows in battle will take proper preparation!」

486:t_046:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「No... $$ゲシュタルト$$ is nothing more than an avatar of $$ズール$$.」

486:t_046:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「So we won't win unless we take down the real one.」

486:t_046:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Then we'll just have to go beat that Emperor $$ズール$$ guy!」

486:t_046:4.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Then we'll just have to go beat that Emperor $$ズール$$ guy!」

486:t_046:5.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Then we'll just have to go beat that Emperor $$ズール$$ guy!」

486:t_046:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Though I don't know where he went...」

486:t_046:7.en:
$$タケル$$
(What are these preparations they talk about...? What in the world is waiting there...?)

486:t_047:1.en:
$$ダリー$$
「We're twins who've always been together, after all.」

486:t_047:2.en:
$$ギミー$$
「We're the Non-$$いがみ合う双子$$, after all! I'm counting on you from now on too, $$ダリー$$!」

486:t_047:3.en:
$$ダリー$$
「Right back at you, $$ギミー$$.」

486:t_100:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I got into an EVA to fight the Angels...)

486:t_100:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
(Those days were painful, but they were a lot better than now...)

486:t_100:2.en:
$$シンジ$$
(...But I can't go back to those days anymore...)

486:t_101:0.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Hah! So that's an Angel I've only ever seen in data!」

486:t_101:1.en:
$$アスカ$$
「But it's one even Brat $$シンジ$$ could beat! There's no way I'll lose now!」

486:t_102:0.en:
$$アスカ$$
(The Angel from the very first battle... The one from when I first met Brat $$シンジ$$...)

486:t_102:1.en:
$$アスカ$$
(I can't go back to those days anymore...! I'm not the me from back then, either!)

486:t_103:0.en:
$$タケル$$
(I can feel Big Bro inside me...)

486:t_103:1.en:
$$タケル$$
(I'll do it, Big Bro...! No matter what future awaits, I'll fight for the vow I made with you!)

486:t_104:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go, $$グーラ$$! From today on, you're one of us!」

486:t_104:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
「You'd call even someone like me a comrade...」

486:t_104:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Good. If a friend of mine were troubled, I'd be troubled too.」

486:t_104:6.en:
$$グーラ$$
「It has a nice ring to it.」

486:t_104:7.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do this, $$グーラ$$! We're counting on your strength!」

486:t_104:8.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Understood! I'll do what I can for this universe too!」

486:t_105:0.en:
$$万丈$$
(Father... Even now, I have no intention of forgiving you...)

486:t_105:1.en:
$$万丈$$
(But somewhere in my heart, I may think that you, too, believed in the future of humanity...)

486:t_105:2.en:
$$万丈$$
(I will advance into the future in a way different from yours. Together with this $$ダイターン３$$...!)

486:t_106:0.en:
$n
(Beyond light and darkness... That is what a human is...)

486:t_106:1.en:
$n
(What lies beyond conflicting emotions was the very essence of the $$いがみ合う双子$$...)

486:t_107:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
(He showed up as if he'd known we were in trouble...)

486:t_107:2.en:
$$アポロ$$
(Just who the hell is that guy...)

491:t_1:3.en: ～ $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ Command Room ～

491:t_1:4.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「...So you're saying the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ and the $$クォーター$$ have grasped $$アマルガム$$'s ultimate objective?」

491:t_1:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We don't know the details either. The transmission from Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ only conveyed an emergency and the rendezvous point.」

491:t_1:6.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Then we have no choice but to hear the details after we rendezvous.」

491:t_1:7.en:
$$ブライト$$
「As for the situation in space, we've managed to secure the cooperation of the group under $$ハマーン・カーン$$, who defected from $$ネオ・ジオン$$, and of $$ギュネイ・ガス$$.」

kept_omissions: 486:t_046:0: Aoi's 倒したの has no subject; rendered 'Did we beat it?' (Gestalt has no gender, so 'it').
486:t_046:6: Lal'C's あいつ = Emperor Xul, rendered 'he'.
486:t_040:6: Fudou's 進め is an imperative to 彼等 spoken to Crea; rendered 'Now they must see ... advance' (third person).
486:t_102:0: 初めて戦った使徒 - who fought it is not stated; rendered 'The Angel from the very first battle' to stay neutral.
486:t_105:1: Banjo thought - subject dropped, kept as 'I may think that you, too, believed...'.
uncertain: 486:t_047:2: いがみ合わない双子 rendered 'Non-$$いがみ合う双子$$' (pun on the keyword; prefix outside token).
486:t_040:6: Fudou speaks to Crea about the young pilots but the imperative is really for them.
486:t_102:0: which Angel and whose first battle (Asuka's thought) is unclear.
486:t_041:0: 高次元生命体の務めの名の下 read as the reason Fudou et al. abandoned the True War.
486:t_104:4: 友達が困っていたら僕も困っちゃう read as Shotaro replying to Gura's worry about being called a comrade.
486:t_107:1: speaker is Amata but the thought continues Kagura's; kept as a continuation.
486:t_042:4: 父上 = Space Demon King (Gura's father), rendered 'Father'.
486:t_046:3-5: identical Nono/Buster Machine/Diebuster lines, same text used.
